text:
Sam Torres: Morning team  Sam here, joining infra this week. Need help with a few cloud access items for onboarding tests:
- Link billing account `sandbox-billing-2026` to project `redwood-sam-test` (I want to boot tiny GPU VMs in asia-east1 and europe-west4)
- Grant my user `roles/compute.admin` on that project and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for `sa-sam@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
- Request regional access to asia-east1 and europe-west4 (low-level dev testing only)
- GPU quota bump: +1 A100 GPU in asia-east1 for short experiments
- AWS cross-account read-only to acct `345678901234` and S3 ListObjects on `redwood-gpu-checkpoints`
Also seeing "invalid_grant" when using gcloud with Okta CLI flow. Any quick tips? Thanks!

Rina Patel: welcome Sam! For billing link ping billing-team; include project id and expected monthly spend (one-liner). For Okta CLI error try re-running `gcloud auth login` and re-enroll MFA if needed.

Sam Torres: Added justification: "onboarding infra tests; non-prod spend < $40/month"

Marcus Li: tagging security. If you're requesting prod-ish resources (A100) we need manager approval and a short data classification. Also prefer granting `compute.admin` only if you need wide privileges; otherwise `compute.instanceAdmin.v1` + `compute.networkAdmin` is safer.

Sam Torres: Manager is Rina Patel. Data will be synthetic prompts only. I'm fine with the narrower role; change to `compute.instanceAdmin.v1` + `compute.networkAdmin` please.

billing-bot: Billing link request BILL-1308 created for project `redwood-sam-test`. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1308

iam-bot: Please confirm the principal email for role grant. Also note: serviceAccountUser will be applied to `sa-sam@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Time-limited AWS role recommended (72h).

Sam Torres: Email is `sam.torres@redwood.com`. Time-limited AWS 72h is fine.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-5157 created for IAM, quota, and AWS setup. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5157

Marcus Li: Security ack pending manager approval. Rina please confirm A100 test OK.

Rina Patel: Approved for a single A100 test in asia-east1 for onboarding. Keep access time-limited and monitor usage.

sec-bot: Security noted: A100 quota for onboarding approved. Ensure SA tokens are short-lived and storage access is read-only. Will audit after expiry.

iam-bot: Applied `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` and `roles/compute.networkAdmin` to `sam.torres@redwood.com` at 1923456840. Granted `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` to CI principal for `sa-sam`.

ops-bot: GPU quota request submitted to GCP for +1 A100 in asia-east1 at 1923456860. AWS temp role request created for 72h for account `345678901234` (S3 ListObjects on `redwood-gpu-checkpoints`).

Sam Torres: Okta CLI issue resolved after re-enrolling MFA. Verified I can create a small instance and see GPU quota pending. Thanks!

billing-bot: Billing linked at 1923456892. Please verify project appears under Billing.

Sam Torres: Confirmed billing visibility and instance creation works. Will wait for A100 approval and AWS role.

ops-bot: GPU quota granted at 1923456915. AWS role active; use `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::345678901234:role/Redwood-ReadOnly --role-session-name sam-temp`. Closing once you confirm S3 list access.

Sam Torres: Confirmed S3 List access and A100 available. Everything green for onboarding tests. Thanks everyone!
